title: Spot the warning signs
description: Scammers often create urgency so you act before you think. Pause, check who contacted you, and use a trusted way to verify their story.
example: “Your account will close in 10 minutes. Send the one-time code now.” A real support agent should not ask you to share that code.

questions.prompt: A message says you must act in 10 minutes. What should you do first?
questions.explanation: Urgency is a common tactic. Use an official app or a number you already trust.
